title: Decision: iv_set flag prevents write before IV is set
description: iv_set is set true only after set_iv()/gen_iv() succeeds; write() returns -EINVAL if set_iv\!=NULL and \!iv_set; RESET clears iv_set (fd.c:352-355, 682, 732, 1108). This is correct: reusing the same IV+key pair on a stream cipher destroys the keystream and enables plaintext recovery. By requiring explicit SET_IV/GEN_IV after each RESET, the API forces awareness of IV semantics. A reviewer suggesting 'auto-generate an IV if write() is called without SET_IV' would hide a critical operation from the caller and break deterministic testing with NIST CAVP vectors.
close_reason: Reviewed, documented, and hardened in CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, and AGENTS.md
